chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Whoever reveres Allah and regards Him too exalted to swear falsely by Him, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will give him something better than what has gone from him.

key_terms.أَجَلَّ: held in exalted reverence and magnified
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; a formula of glorification for Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for refusing to swear a false oath by Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches reverence for Allah by avoiding false oaths in His Name, even when one may suffer worldly loss by telling the truth. It promises that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will compensate such a person with something better than what he gave up.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4299 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever reveres Allah (swt) and refrains from swearing a false oath by Him (swt), Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, will grant him something better than what he has lost."
